headline.text: L3 ML4 ran out of flow wrap at 10:35, stopped depositing; L2 ML2 ran out of rice at 11:00, *1 hour down* until material arrived at 12:15

per_plant_summary.L1: Ran caramel lines with routine adjustments. S1 riser pump faulted at 05:41 but cleared after reheat. Live cockroach found on pallet during 3rd shift—pallet removed, area inspection underway. S2 bottomer west bearing flagged as deteriorating.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 printer faulted four times across 2nd and 3rd shifts, cleared each time by priming mixing tank. Ran out of rice at 11:00, back up at 12:15 once material arrived. ML3 belt broke at 18:51, replaced and running again by 19:12.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 TG5 drive belt came off at 16:26, roller seized—cleared by 16:57. Ran out of flow wrap at 10:35, stopped depositing PTLs. Dirty molds causing bar stains; sensitivity adjustment requested. Roof leak continues, follow-up scheduled.

notes.text: S1 hopper level configuration adjusted to reduce caramel scrap—new setpoints running stable throughout shift.
FFS pouch film arrived and staged at 12:20.

resolved.title: S2 Tunnel 3 roller cover hitting side
resolved.summary: Roller cover not assembled correctly after maintenance work, creating small shavings during operation.
resolved.resolution: Covers properly installed, cleaned, and approved to keep running by 14:38 (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: S2 jar label positioning off-center
resolved.summary: Labels visibly misaligned on new short jar geometry due to 2mm taper from top to bottom.
resolved.resolution: Approved to run as-is by Kandy Mondragon and Curt Willis at 15:40 with documentation.

resolved.title: S1 water activity out of range
resolved.summary: Initial caramel aW test result high; QA concerned even after second reading still slightly elevated.
resolved.resolution: Third sample tested at 19:17, result within range (Angelica Perez to Italu Martinez).

resolved.title: S1 riser pump high-pressure fault
resolved.summary: Pump faulted and stopped at 05:41, temper system down.
resolved.resolution: Pre-reheat done long enough for pump to restart at 05:50, temper running again (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: S2 chocolate filter pin missing
resolved.summary: Filter could not be installed because retaining pin was not in place after Thursday issue.
resolved.resolution: Pin found by Nathan Coles at 23:00, filter installed and pressure verified OK.

resolved.title: ML3 conveyor belt broken
resolved.summary: Belt snapped at 18:51, line stopped for replacement.
resolved.resolution: New belt installed, line running again at 19:12.

resolved.title: ML2 film cutting blades not working
resolved.summary: Blades not cutting film cleanly starting at 03:59, line stopped for troubleshooting.
resolved.resolution: Back up at 04:52 after cleaning chocolate from under forming plate, CIL, soft reset, and B19 sensor adjustment (Fernando Flores).

resolved.title: ML2 ran out of rice
resolved.summary: Depositing stopped at 11:00 when rice hopper emptied, cooler running empty.
resolved.resolution: Rice arrived and loaded into Hapman by 12:03, depositing again at 12:15 (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: ML2 printer faults recurring
resolved.summary: Printer threw makeup fault four times across 2nd and 3rd shifts starting at 12:49, requiring line stops each time.
resolved.resolution: Cleared each time by priming mixing tank per Shawn's instructions; VJ tech replaced solvent control module last week, full ink system replacement on backorder.

resolved.title: ML4 TG5 drive belt off, roller seized
resolved.summary: Small belt not spinning at 16:17, drive belt frayed and came off seized roller causing bars to melt.
resolved.resolution: Belt replaced and TG5 running again at 16:57 after burning off frayed material (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: ML1 temper slope high throughout shift
resolved.summary: Slope hitting 0.7 repeatedly during 2nd shift, requiring stops; pre-cooling temp elevated.
resolved.resolution: Cold water dropped to 48°, pre-cooling to 89.5° per Shawn's guidance; confirmed acceptable to run at 0.7 per Feastables spec update at 20:00.

resolved.title: MFM bags with stains and defective units
resolved.summary: Stains on bag fronts, many poorly sealed or empty units reaching boxes during 2nd shift.
resolved.resolution: Area cleaned, team instructed to check and remove defects; verified corrected by 18:10 (Lorena Abreu).

resolved.title: Truffle M4 belt shifting out of position
resolved.summary: M4 belt tracking north repeatedly across shift; scraper also not contacting belt properly.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance adjusted belt position at 17:00 and scraper position at 00:57 (Jose Vasquez), belt centered and stable.

resolved.title: ML4 gondola filling level warning
resolved.summary: Gondola hit 88% full at 19:49, alarm sounded and stopped WDS.
resolved.resolution: Percentage back in green, line resumed; reduced to 18 mpm until TG back to two lines, then returned to 25 mpm.

resolved.title: ML4 TG3 bouncing as if loose
resolved.summary: TG3 alarm at 23:47, visibly bouncing during operation.
resolved.resolution: Lifted and tightened at 23:56, back up (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: ML1 frozen pipes at startup
resolved.summary: Line couldn't start at shift open, pipes frozen.
resolved.resolution: Temper unit back to good temper, started running at 04:25 (Raoul Lubain).

resolved.title: MFM suction cups not opening bags
resolved.summary: Machine not opening bags correctly at 08:17, suspected suction cup misalignment.
resolved.resolution: Nelson adjusted suction cups, now lined up and working at 08:49.

resolved.title: ML4 TG5 door randomly opened and bent
resolved.summary: Door opened on its own at 11:37, difficult to close due to bent condition.
resolved.resolution: Nelson Cook straightened door, fixed by 11:40.

needs_attention.title: S1 live cockroach found on pallet
needs_attention.summary: Employee saw live cockroach on finished-goods pallet during 3rd shift; pallet removed from production area.
needs_attention.status: Pallet taken away by 23:24; Curt Willis instructed Jody Howse to inspect area for additional insects as of 23:29.

needs_attention.title: S2 bottomer west bearing deteriorating
needs_attention.summary: Maintenance identified bearing going out, potential for failure if not replaced soon.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance keeping an eye on it as of 07:57.

needs_attention.title: S2 first row chocolates damaged by conveyor
needs_attention.summary: First row coming out damaged due to belt movement, needs person assigned to remove damaged pieces.
needs_attention.status: QA requested staffing to remove damaged pieces as of 08:38; operator indicated issue is belt movement.

needs_attention.title: S2 pallet missing 'L' from lot code
needs_attention.summary: Pallet just set aside at 11:24 due to incomplete lot label printing (missing letter L).
needs_attention.status: Team lead reviewing pallet to check jars as of 11:24.

needs_attention.title: ML4 out of flow wrap film
needs_attention.summary: Ran out of flow wrap at 10:35, stopped adding chocolate to PTLs to avoid accumulation.
needs_attention.status: Depositing stopped at 10:35 due to packaging shortage; 36,750 FW on hold may have been discarded.

needs_attention.title: ML1 printer fault, parts needed
needs_attention.summary: Printer stopped at 20:32 on 2nd shift; maintenance swapped in printer from ML4 TG4 but mixing tank parts remain on backorder.
needs_attention.status: Running on TG4 printer as of 03:52; Chris Givens following up with VJ on ink system ETA as of 08:04.

needs_attention.title: ML4 dirty molds causing bar stains
needs_attention.summary: Bars showing small stains every 8 molds due to dirty molds not being rejected automatically by vision system.
needs_attention.status: Itzel cleaning licking roller and looking into sensitivity adjustment as of 10:25; QA requested automatic rejection sensitivity increase.

needs_attention.title: MFM bag opening problems persisting
needs_attention.summary: Machine continues having trouble opening bags correctly despite earlier suction cup adjustment at 08:49.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance present as of 12:13, problem ongoing.

needs_attention.title: Roof leak above warehouse area
needs_attention.summary: Same roof area leaking again after last week's patch; buckets placed, pallets moved by WH.
needs_attention.status: Superior Roofing patched last Wednesday; Rose and Preston following up as of 18:29.
